  apple-xctest-startup:
    needs: tooling
    if: inputs.profile == 'ios-xctest-startup' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/development/preview-hardening'
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 18
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Select one actual iPhone without Kotlin, Gradle, Java or Rust setup
        id: runtime
        run: |
          python3 -B scripts/ci/native_ui_input_startup.py --select-simulator
          device="$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("build/ci-verification/xctest-startup/selection.json"))["udid"])')"
          state="$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("build/ci-verification/xctest-startup/selection.json"))["state"])')"
          if [[ "$state" != Shutdown && "$state" != Booted ]]; then
            echo 'Unknown selected simulator state; never choose another device' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          printf 'device=%s\ninitial_state=%s\n' "$device" "$state" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [[ "$state" == Shutdown ]]; then
            /usr/bin/xcrun simctl boot "$device"
          fi
          /usr/bin/xcrun simctl bootstatus "$device" -b
      - name: Independent Swift XCTest readiness and zero-input completion only
        env:
          SELECTED_SIMULATOR: ${{ steps.runtime.outputs.device }}
        run: python3 -B scripts/ci/native_ui_input_startup.py --simulator "$SELECTED_SIMULATOR"
      - name: Restore only this job's previously shut-down simulator
        if: always() && steps.runtime.outputs.initial_state == 'Shutdown'
        env:
          SELECTED_SIMULATOR: ${{ steps.runtime.outputs.device }}
        run: |
          /usr/bin/xcrun simctl shutdown "$SELECTED_SIMULATOR"
          python3 -B scripts/ci/native_ui_input_startup.py --restore-check "$SELECTED_SIMULATOR"
      - name: Keep bounded source, startup and owning cleanup receipts only
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: independent-xctest-startup
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            build/ci-verification/xctest-startup/receipt.json
            build/ci-verification/xctest-startup/selection.json
            build/ci-verification/xctest-startup/restored.json
